tldr: Ad search now queries the BM25 and vector indexes in parallel and merges the results with reciprocal rank fusion.
A hybrid_ranking flag controls the new behaviour, and the vector side now has a time limit.
The fusion maths and the vector time limit are the parts most likely to break relevance silently.

components.name: Search API
components.summary: SearchController fans out to both retrievers and waits up to 120 ms for the vector side before falling back to BM25 only.

components.name: RRF fusion
components.summary: New pure function that merges two ranked hit lists by summing 1 / (k + rank).

components.name: Vector index client
components.summary: Thin HTTP client for the vector index with a per-request timeout.

components.name: Legacy synonym booster
components.summary: Hand-maintained synonym table replaced by vector retrieval.

diagram_before:
flowchart LR
  Client[Search page] --> SearchAPI[Search API]
  SearchAPI --> SYN[Synonym booster]
  SYN --> ES[(BM25 index)]
diagram_after:
flowchart LR
  Client[Search page] --> SearchAPI[Search API]
  SearchAPI --> ES[(BM25 index)]
  SearchAPI -->|in parallel| VEC[(Vector index)]
  ES --> RRF[RRF fusion]
  VEC --> RRF
  RRF --> SearchAPI

hotspots.why_it_matters: BM25 ranks arrive 1-based but the vector ranks come from withIndex(), which starts at 0. Every vector hit gets a small, systematic boost over BM25.
hotspots.headline: The two rank lists are fused on different scales

hotspots.why_it_matters: The vector timeout is caught as Exception, which includes CancellationException, so cancelling the request doesn't stop the BM25 call.
hotspots.headline: A client disconnect is swallowed and BM25 keeps running

hotspots.why_it_matters: The vector call is made even when hybrid_ranking is off, so the flag doesn't stop the new load on the vector cluster.
hotspots.headline: The flag doesn't stop the vector call

extras_not_requested: Removed the legacy synonym booster, which also affects non-hybrid traffic
possibly_missing: No metric for how often the vector call times out
Flag off still calls the vector index

tests_added: RrfTest.kt: 6 cases covering ties, disjoint lists and k values
weak_spots: No test for the timeout fallback path
No test that the flag-off path skips the vector call

reviewer_questions: With hybrid_ranking off, what does a search request cost the vector cluster?
Are BM25 ranks 0-based or 1-based by the time they reach fuse()?
Is removing the synonym booster safe before the flag is at 100%?
low_risk_collapsed: build.gradle.kts: adds the HTTP client dependency

quiz.setup: hybrid_ranking is off for a user, and they search for 'cheap phone'.
quiz.question: Is the vector index called?
options: Yes, and the result is thrown away
quiz.explain: The async vector call starts before the flag is checked; the flag only decides whether the results are fused.

quiz.setup: The vector index takes 300 ms to answer a query.
quiz.question: What does the user get?
options: BM25 results only, after about 120 ms
quiz.explain: The client gives up after 120 ms and the catch block turns that into an empty vector list, so only BM25 hits are ranked.

quiz.setup: A document is ranked first by both BM25 and the vector index.
quiz.question: Which list contributes more to its fused score?
quiz.explain: Vector ranks start at 0, so the top hit scores 1/60 there but 1/61 from BM25. Small, but it tilts every result.

tour.text: A search still enters through the Search API.
It now asks both indexes at once, and the vector side has a time limit.
Reciprocal rank fusion merges the two ranked lists into one.
The API returns the fused list.
